description.value:
A billowing storm of Force-fed flame erupts at a point you choose within range, filling as many as ten contiguous 10-foot cubes arranged however you like, each sharing at least one face with another. Every creature caught within must attempt a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 energy damage on a failure or half as much on a success; a creature in more than one cube is affected only once.

The flame scorches objects in the area and ignites unattended flammable material.
